In my experience, green curries tend to be spicier than others. It could be depending on the dish or restaurant too.

I've found most little Asian places will make your food to order, so if you ask them to make it spicier they almost always oblige.

Also look into Malaysian food - similar but they have a bit more emphasis on savory and spicy than some other countries' food.

I use a red curry paste (Mai Ploy brand). Sautée it with some oil, garlic, shallot, and grated ginger. You can probably just toss in meat and veg with that alone. I like to tone it down with grated palm sugar and a few minutes before in done I add coconut milk for coconut curry. For a kapoon (soup) I add home make chicken stock and some water. I use about 1T curry and 2T oil but for more spice you can add more curry and chopped or puréed Thai chili peppers.
